quote.text: The good things which belong to prosperity are to be wished, but the good things that belong to adversity are to be admired.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Adversity in family life, though difficult, teaches our children resilience and perseverance—qualities that mere comfort cannot instill.
    • While prosperity offers pleasant moments, it is the challenges that deepen our bonds and cultivate character in both parent and child.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, facing adverse circumstances reveals inner strength and inspires trust; hardships demand authenticity and fortitude.
    • Prosperity brings opportunity, yet it is during times of adversity that true leadership shines by guiding others through uncertainty with wisdom and courage.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, challenges and setbacks often foster creativity and drive innovation, compelling us to think beyond conventional solutions.
    • While success is gratifying, it is the adversity—through trials and errors—that refines our products and sharpens our strategic insights for sustainable growth.
